gaps.finding: Every major AI crawler is permitted and a sitemap is declared. The engines can read the site — this is not the constraint.

gaps.finding: The homepage carries no structured data at all — 0 JSON-LD blocks. Nothing on the site tells an engine what this company is or what it sells. Gemini cites zero pages.

recommendations.rationale: Branded queries respond to source availability, not to accumulated authority, so this is the only track that can move before a launch.
deliverables: Citable answers for is-Icon-legit / pricing / vs-Billo / vs-Soona
Review velocity across Trustpilot, G2, Capterra

recommendations.rationale: Roundup placements and review-site authority are what the engines actually read for category questions, and they accumulate slowly.
deliverables: Comparison pages vs Billo, Soona, Arcads, Insense

recommendations.rationale: Launch coverage is the raw material engines will cite for the next year; unstructured, it is wasted on this channel.
deliverables: Post-launch re-run of the full prompt set
